prompt:
The FIRST reference image is the APPROVED DESIGN: an adorable angel version of the Anthropic
"Clawd" pixel mascot, as a cute designed-sticker pixel-art mark — a stepped blocky coral body
(coral #DD775B, darker #c05f45 shading low, lighter #ea9077 highlight band near the top), two
big dark rounded eyes each with a single small white glint, four little pixel legs dangling
below as it floats, classic cream/off-white (#fffdf7 / #f3ead9) scalloped angel wings spread
one on each side growing from BEHIND the body (never held, never attached in front), a simple
golden-cream pixel halo floating just above its head, and a small burnt-orange pixel heart
floating beside its head. The SECOND reference image is the original Clawd pixel mascot, the
character identity underneath.

Reproduce the FIRST reference's design FAITHFULLY — same style, same proportions, same
colors, same plush charming sticker energy, crisp flat blocky pixel shapes, not a rigid grid
port, not painterly, not 3D, not glossy — changing ONLY the one thing named next.

CHANGE: move the burnt-orange pixel heart so it floats centered directly ABOVE the critter's head, nestled in the gap between the top of the head and the halo. Everything else identical.

COMPOSITION: the critter floats centered, large in frame, entirely surrounded by background.
BACKGROUND: a single flat solid field of pure bright green #00FF00 and nothing else — no
shadow, no reflection, no surface, no gradient, no vignette; the green touches all four
edges. ABSOLUTELY NO text, no letters, no numbers. Do NOT include any flag.
